meaning: This is the producer tag for CBMIX whose real name is Chris Barnett is a producer from Chicago, IL who has produced for Chief Keef, Lil Pump,  Juice WLRD, Wiz Khalifa, Nick Bean and Chance The Rapper. His most notable songs he has produced  are “Mixtape,” by Chance The Rapper and  “ESSKEETIT” by Lil Pump
